source_segments.text: Harold was a son of Godwin ( c.
1001 –1053 ) , the powerful Earl of Wessex , and of Gytha Thorkelsdóttir , whose brother Ulf the Earl was married to Estrid Svendsdatter ( c.
1015/1016 ) , the daughter of King Sweyn Forkbeard [ 2 ] ( died 1014 ) and sister of King Cnut the Great of England and Denmark .
Ulf and Estrid 's son would become King Sweyn II of Denmark [ 3 ] in 1047 .
Godwin was the son of Wulfnoth , probably a thegn and a native of Sussex .
